title: Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
body:
Syntax: perform eight trigrams sixty-four palms [target]

Minimum level 65, Byakugan mastery 22% and inherited Potential 0 or higher. This is a clan-exclusive Gentle Fist technique, dealing damage to the opponent and targeting chakra/stamina pathways. Successful hits may seal tenketsu briefly, stopping jutsu use. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
